results.title: Performance results
results.calloutCritical: “{name}” exceeded the critical limit for this period (recorded value {value}; critical: {limit}). Identifying the related obstacles is recommended.
results.calloutWarning: “{name}” passed the warning limit (recorded value {value}; warning: {limit}). Keep it under follow-up; you can open a problem to identify its obstacles.
results.tableCaption: Indicator results grouped by indicator group
results.note: The performance level comes only from comparing the value with the limits; it does not indicate the cause of a deviation.
results.auditText: Who entered the data and when, and decisions taken on this assessment
results.handledText: These deviations are no longer active alerts because their problems were treated or documented.

audit.readings_entered: Readings entered for {count, plural, one {# indicator} other {# indicators}} (entered by {enteredBy})

audit.problem_opened_auto: A problem was opened automatically for “{indicator}” (critical limit exceeded)

drawer.subtitle: {plant} · {period}

resultText.insufficient_data: Not enough data; no result was calculated.
resultText.no_limits: No approved limits; the value is recorded for reference only.

drawer.historyMissing: Some periods have no value (insufficient data).
